subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about driving validated web sales for {Brand} on a cost-per-sale basis, the way we did for commerce brands like Revolve and Lulus. The one point worth repeating: you pay per completed order that survives your returns window, deduped on the order ID, so the commercial risk sits with us until the sale clears. At scale that runs around 7,000 validated purchases a day. If it helps, I can share the category-level sales view this week. Worth a short look?
angle: warm bump, restate cost-per-sale validated-purchase + risk-on-us proof
register_notes: Stage 1 EN ecommerce CPS: references prior in first sentence; restates single proof (cost-per-sale validated purchase + order-ID dedup + return-adjusted, risk-on-us); one illustrative MobUpps figure (7,000 validated purchases/day, flagged); reuses only parent brands (Revolve, Lulus); soft CTA, 1 question mark; native American-English; no sign-off; no em-dash; no X-not-Y.
